Introduction rewritten. Key changes from the old version:

- **Reframed** from "exceptions help" to "complete traces hurt" (para 1 drops the 18+pp comparison, para 4 centers on traces barely beating source code)
- **B5 regex promoted** to primary baseline in para 4 (line 16), with nomarker rebuttal immediately following (line 17)
- **"information overload"** appears once in quotes (line 19), all subsequent uses are "diagnostic signal dilution"
- **Contribution list** replaced with the new C1-C4 structure (format matching separated as C2, two-tier hierarchy as C3)
- **Tail-truncation** reframed at ~512 tokens with globals dump threshold (line 21)
- All writing constraints satisfied: no em-dashes, no -ing phrase endings, no stacked transition words, every number has a section reference
